answer_2.quote: We also evaluate the T2I models using various metrics, including CLIP-T, CLIP-I, and DINO Score. For comparison, we also incorporate two MLLM-based evaluation methods, TIFA Score and LLMScore ... We also evaluate using traditional metrics such as FID, IS, and CLIPScore.

answer_3.quote: We employ an advanced multi-modal LLM combined with the reference image as an effective proxy for the human evaluator to assess the factuality of the generated image ... We test several closed-source models, including GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Flash, and Qwen-VL-Max, alongside several open-source models such as Qwen2.5-VL-72B and InternVL-2.5-78B.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations on iTAG platform. Specifically, we engaged three annotators to evaluate Concept Factuality, Instantiation Completeness, and Composition Factuality ... The questions presented to the annotators were consistent with the prompts for GPT-4o.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to answer questions assessing Concept Factuality, Instantiation Completeness, and Composition Factuality, using criteria such as shape, color, texture, feature details, seamless transition, visual completeness, authenticity, and prompt following.
